entities.name: Břetislav Rychlík
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Břetislav Rychlík is a Czech actor and director. He was born in Uherské Hradiště and began his career at the local theater. Later he worked in the theater in Brno and also taught at Janáček Academy of Music and Performing Arts. He also directed several documentary films.
